title: Megurine Luka — A Happy Doll Festival♪〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Humhumhuuum♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hm? You look like you're having fun, Miku!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe♪ I have a feeling that something really, really good is gonna happen today☆

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Something really good? Like what?
Tsukasa and the others coming over, maybe?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hmm... I dunno♪
But I'm so excited...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What? Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
No, look☆
All the plushies are running this way!

rows.Speaker: Plushie A
rows.Line:
Miku! Len!
Heeelp!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Whoa! What's wrong, you guys?

rows.Speaker: Plushie B
rows.Line:
Just come with us! Hurry!
We need your help!

rows.Speaker: Plushie A
rows.Line: Here! Over here!

rows.Speaker: Plushie B
rows.Line: Look! Her!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Her? Where...? Ohhh...!!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: *Mumble*...

rows.Speaker: Miku & Len
rows.Line: L-Luka?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yay♪ I didn't know you were here☆

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Me neither! But why's she asleep?
Luka... Luka, wake up...!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
*Yawn*...
Hm...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Luka! Good morning☆

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Huh...? Miku? Len?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yes, it's us! We're so glad you're here!
This SEKAI is just so much fun♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It really is♪ Especially all the shows we do!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Shows? That does sound like fun...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But... Um...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh? Luka?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Zzz... Zzz...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
She fell asleep! No, Luka, wake up!
If you can get yourself to that stage over there, you can see KAITO and MEIKO too...!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Don't forget Rin!
Luka, wake up! Let's go!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
*Yawn*... Oh...!
KAITO and MEIKO are here too?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: They are! Everyone's gonna be so happy to hear that you're here now!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, I'd like to see them too.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Then come with us and you can do just that☆

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We can guide you around this SEKAI too☆

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe. This should be fun.
Thank you, Miku, Len.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Alright, let's start by heading over to the stage to see KAITO and MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Okay, let's... Oh, what's that...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Wait, Luka, where are you going?!
You too, Miku! It's not that way...!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hello, little flowers.
My name is Luka. It's nice to meet you.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, you're such good singers.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Such a gentle song too. I must just...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Found you, Luka☆

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Zzz...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh?! She fell asleep again?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Wait... Oh, I know!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Flowers, could you sing a more upbeat song that might be able to wake her up?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, this is nice. Such a happy song...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
You did it! Luka's awake!
Great idea, Len♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hehe. It's all thanks to the flowers!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Alright, let's take this opportunity to go find KAITO and the others.

rows.Speaker: Plushie A
rows.Line: Hey, it's them! Over there!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, it's the plushies from before.
And...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hey, it really is Luka!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Welcome, Luka!
We've been waiting for you.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. The plushies told us that Miku and Len would take me to see you, but I guess this ended up being faster...!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I suppose so, but I'm glad we're finally all together♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Thank goodness, you're all here♪
I wasn't sure we'd be able to make it to you on our own...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I know, right? It's like Luka can fall asleep anywhere at anytime...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But she's cute, so it's all good. She just looks so soft and cuddly☆

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haha. We should tell everyone else that we have a new friend with us now.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yeah♪ We should as soon as we can☆
You wanna meet them too, right, Luka?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, I'd like to.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Especially if their feelings created this SEKAI...♪
